turns.text: Yes, I'm thankfully 100% back to normal! The flu is entirely out of my system. And Tom is doing great! We actually went out to a nice dinner over the weekend to catch up, which was really sweet.

turns.text: I've just got my headphones in, listening to a hilarious audio show where two stand-up comedians discuss weird news stories. It's a really funny podcast, and I've been struggling not to laugh out loud in the breakroom!

turns.text: Haha, holding in a laugh in a quiet breakroom is always a challenge! A good comedic show is the perfect way to reset during a busy shift.

turns.text: It really is. It takes my mind off work completely. I've only got a few hours left of my shift today, and then I'm looking forward to just relaxing at home.
